label: Customer address
action: Add the customer's service address to the invoice.

label: Customer email
action: Capture the customer's email so receipts and correspondence can be shown.

label: Signed estimate
action: Get the estimate signed before starting work.

label: Terms accepted
action: Have the customer accept your terms (refund / cancellation policy).

label: Technician GPS check-in
action: Have the technician check in on site with GPS.

label: Completion signature
action: Collect the customer's signature when the job is done.
unavailableAction: Start using completion signatures in the mobile app (available since December 2025; your team has not used it yet).

label: Before photos
action: Take before photos of the problem.

label: After photos
action: Upload after photos of the finished work.

label: Detailed job description
action: Write a job description of at least 80 characters (what was wrong, what was done).

label: Receipt sent
action: Send the customer a receipt now.
